recommendation: Keep the source fix. No further core change is needed for the Observation element, encounter search parameter, or episode-of-care extension unless a future work-group decision reverses the current Encounter-plus-extension model.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 OO issue requesting Observation.context be changed back to Observation.encounter, narrowed from Reference(Encounter|EpisodeOfCare) to Reference(Encounter), with the Observation search parameter updated and EpisodeOfCare support moved to an event/workflow extension.
initial_application: The request was pre-applied in commit 096d9cd98c16d6b06712455ca04ece365fb5bddc, which changed historical Observation source and examples from context to encounter. Current Observation source defines Observation.encounter as 0..1 Reference(Encounter), and the Observation encounter search parameter uses code encounter with expression Observation.encounter.
additional_context: The original Zulip thread records the intended split: one Encounter reference on Observation and repeatable EpisodeOfCare linkage via an extension, with search parameters split accordingly. The extension now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack as workflow-episodeOfCare and includes Observation in both extension contexts and workflow-EpisodeOfCare search bases. Later FHIR-33166 kept the model and added workflow-episodeOfCare guidance to Observation.encounter; FHIR-17662 and FHIR-33166 are already audited on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Made a source-changing commit to correct source/secpriv-module.html, an active Security and Privacy module page, so it no longer tells implementers that Observation.context can point to Encounter or EpisodeOfCare. The fixed text names Observation.encounter, the workflow-episodeOfCare extension, and Observation.performer as references that may need de-identification.
source_changes: source/secpriv-module.html: changed stale de-identification guidance from Observation.context value of Encounter or EpisodeOfCare to Observation.encounter plus the workflow-episodeOfCare extension.

related_jiras.note: Companion Published/Persuasive OO issue applying the same context-to-encounter split to other OO event/request resources; already represented on the combined branch.

Later Applied OO issue asking to revisit Observation.encounter/context; final resolution kept Observation.encounter and added workflow-episodeOfCare guidance, already represented on the combined branch.
Later workflow-EpisodeOfCare search-parameter decision implemented in the Extension Pack and already represented on the combined branch.
